title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1982-09-15
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi CR-5A > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > CD-Wave (24bit output) > TLH > FLAC 2448 tagged. Transferred by Andrew F. 12/2015
source: AUD: Nakamichi CM300/CP-4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5 > Maxell XLII. Set up inside SBD perimeter area for 1st Set, mics moved onto SBD platform for 2nd Set, recording by Brian Schley.

ai_review.summary: Phenomenal master‑recording of a high‑energy show with a blazing Playing in the Band → Crazy Fingers opener and a powerful Touch of Grey.
ai_review.review: The reviewers hail this tape as a “master recording” that captures the band at its peak, noting crystal‑clear sound and an impressive community effort on the second‑set mics. Musically the show bursts open with Playing in the Band into Crazy Fingers and sustains momentum through a standout Touch of Grey, delivering a high‑energy performance throughout.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review praises both the show’s exceptional energy and the excellent soundboard‑type recording, indicating a near‑perfect experience.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a master recording with community‑sourced second‑set mics; clear, crisp, and well balanced.

standout_songs: Playing in the Band > Crazy Fingers
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong opening segue from Playing in the Band into Crazy Fingers sets a high‑octane tone that carries through the rest of the set, maintaining momentum and excitement.
